gates.annotation: // @ts-expect-error negative: invented-message. Every UI call is in the composed catalogue.
// @ts-expect-error negative: cross-kind-answer. Account answers cannot be playlist creation answers.
// @ts-expect-error negative: narrow-first-run. New catalogue members do not widen the first-run handler.
// @ts-expect-error negative: wrong-payload. Playlist reads require explicit refresh intent.
// @ts-expect-error negative: invalid-site. Site validation uses the shared vocabulary.
// @ts-expect-error negative: sender-privacy. A body cannot establish native privacy.
// @ts-expect-error negative: sender-tab. A body cannot establish the active native tab.
// @ts-expect-error negative: body-account. Account selection calls canonical Tabs.
// @ts-expect-error negative: unsupported-privacy. New playlist privacy uses the actual service vocabulary.
// @ts-expect-error negative: promised-result. A wire listing contains a completed finite refresh.
// @ts-expect-error negative: operation-identity. Raw strings cannot name a creation operation.
// @ts-expect-error negative: submit-account. The authenticated operation retains its original account.
// @ts-expect-error negative: body-derived-requester. Only native authentication creates the private brand.
// @ts-expect-error negative: raw-owner-token. Disposable storage authority never crosses UI JSON.
// @ts-expect-error negative: raw-capture-operation. A storage capture is not a form operation identity.
// @ts-expect-error negative: readonly-local-set. UI storage cannot write.
// @ts-expect-error negative: readonly-local-remove. UI storage cannot remove.
// @ts-expect-error negative: readonly-local-clear. UI storage cannot clear.
// @ts-expect-error negative: readonly-local-all. A read names its canonical keys.
// @ts-expect-error negative: dto-origin. Origin comes from the native sender.
// @ts-expect-error negative: dto-review. The review cannot cross the wire.
// @ts-expect-error negative: dto-promise. Permission evidence stays in its process.
// @ts-expect-error negative: operation-result. Setup and agreement answers differ.
// @ts-expect-error negative: operation-args. The pre-consent lookup accepts no agreement body.
// @ts-expect-error negative: subset. Remaining unbuilt calls have no successful placeholder.
// @ts-expect-error negative: account-brand. A native account identifier is not an AccountKey.
// @ts-expect-error negative: playlist-brand. A raw string has not passed validation.
// @ts-expect-error negative: music-scopes. Shortcuts needs an explicit Music disposition.
// @ts-expect-error negative: no-chooser. Playlist choices require an actual chooser port.

gates.annotation: // @ts-expect-error negative: list-open-account. Opening a list requires its account.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-await-generation. Waiting names the exact refresh generation.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-refresh-authority. Refresh cannot replace the captured account.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-release-no-work. Release cannot carry a refresh generation.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-id-brand. Creation and list operations have different identities.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-owner-capture. Owner capture is never a wire operation identity.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-pending-finite. An open answer carries finite refresh metadata.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-refreshed-finite. A completed refresh cannot carry a native callback.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-release-identity. A released answer still names its operation.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-withheld-no-rows. Refused authority cannot expose refreshed rows.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-readonly-time. Picker timestamps remain readonly.
// @ts-expect-error negative: list-refresh-native-privacy. A caller cannot set native privacy.
